english: Ah, Rika.\nActually... I have a worry about 'club'...
Mii~, by club you mean\nthe club they do after school\nat the Hinamizawa branch school?
I'm a club member too.\nTell me what your worry is.\nNipah~☆
Thank you.\nThen I'll take you up on that...\nThe worry is... well...
Well?
...I can't win.\nNot against Mion, not against Rena...\nnot even against Satoko...!
That can't be helped.\nThey do serious matches every day,\nso everyone's freakishly strong.
And since everyone knows each other's hands inside-out...\na latecomer is the perfect mark\nin group games. Nipah~☆
Nipah-ing... think of how I feel,\ntaking an embarrassing penalty game every time...
Poor poor thing.\nI'll at least pat your head.\nPat pat. Pat pat.
I don't really get it, but...
Before you take on the club, want to try\na match with me first?
Will you see how good I am...?\nI'm worried, going in like this.
What game would you like~?
Yakyuken, please.
Mii~? I know baseball, but...\nI don't know much about grown-up games.
Th-then... how about rock-paper-scissors?
There's a lot of luck involved,\nso it wouldn't help much in club.
Let's go with the classic.\nWe'll play 'Old Maid'.
My hands are tiny,\nso could I ask you\nto deal the cards?
Understood. Leave it to me.\n...Is this the old maid? I'll lay it face-down.
Fufu... good...
(Did she just... smile like a totally different, grown-up person...)
What's wrong~?\nDeal them quickly.
Ah, right... ...There, dealt.
Yay! I've got lots of pairs.\nSo many pairs~.
You've got lots left over,\npoor poor thing.\nSo I'll give you the first move.
Urgh... then... I'll take you up on that...
Hmm... so close, but... they won't pair up...
Umm, this one!\nYay!\nAnother pair~.
Wh...?\nH-how...\nBut still!
The last card is... this one!\nYay!\nI'm out~!
Mwaaah! I lost...!\nTo such a little girl...
Don't feel bad.\nI just got lucky, that's all.
That's not lucky...\nThe old maid was this 5 of spades,\nand Rika, you didn't draw it once...
(Of course. I've played countless,\nmind-numbing rounds with these cards)
(Even face-down, I can tell them all apart\nby tiny scratches and creases)
By the way...
Huh...!?\nSurely... this was just to gauge my skill... right?
What are you talking about?\nClub is nothing without a penalty game.
Now, the 'maid outfit'.\nA promise is a promise.\nNipah~☆
Nooo...!
Waaah, it suits you so well.
Ah, Rika.\nSo you were here.
Mii! You startled me.
You're looking for me, so\nthis is about revenge for last time?
But thanks for\nplaying with me.\nNipah~☆
What game are we playing today?
Umm... what should we do...
H-how about a dance-off?
Mii~. You can dance?\nThat's amazing! Show me!
N-no... sorry.\nI can't...
How about a footrace.
Would beating a girl\nin a footrace make you happy?
...Yeah, fair.
For a showdown,\nsimple rules are best.\nI'm good at 'Concentration'.
Got it.\nThen... let's do 'Concentration'.
Then let's shuffle the cards together.\nShuffly... shuffly...\nAll ready!
You let me go first last time,\nso today Rika can go first.
Fuh...
Huh...?
It's nothing.\nLadies first, huh.\nGood boy, good boy. Nipah~☆
I'll take you up on that and go first.\nFirst up... this and... this-.
Ace of spades and ace of hearts!\nA hit right away.\nYou're amazing, Rika.
And I'll keep going.\nThis and... this...!\nYay! Another hit~.
I'm the reincarnation of Oyashiro-sama.\nWith divine powers I can see right through everything~.
Now four in a row!\nHere, here, here, here.\nNipah~☆ All hits~.
Umm... uh... hold on...?\nWait, could this be...?
I'm on a roll.\nI'll take them all!\nHere here here here here here...
Hereherehereherehere~!\nYay~! I did it all! All of theem~!
Th-that's...\nYou can't call this a match, can you...?
Sadly, it is a match.\nI did say I was good\nat Concentration at the start.
And you gave me the first move -\ncarelessness is the greatest enemy.
Huh...?\nRika...?
Now, the penalty game.
Today, nice and simple:\n'drawing pranks on your face\nwith a permanent marker'~. Nipah~☆
Ah... w-wait a second!\nAt least make it washable... could you put that pen down...?
It's fine.\nIt'll fade with time.
Okay, done! Now you won't be\nembarrassed anywhere you go.\nIt suits you so well!
...That's awful...\n*sniff*...
Found you, Rika!
Mii! You startled me.
You're playing with me again~?
You're a troubled pervert\nwho looks forward to\nclub penalty games with glee.
Hey-!\nDon't say such awful-sounding things!\nIt hurts, being called a pervert...
If you're not a pervert, what are you?
A gentleman.\nA plain gentleman, no pervert attached.
How unique.
Normally,\n'gentleman' doesn't come\nwith 'pervert' attached.
I'm a gambler. A true one.\nI love, love, love gambling.
Zawawa... zawawa...
That's the sugarcane-field one...
To avoid the penalty game,\nI want to get stronger...!
If you can't beat me,\nbeating Mii or Rena\nis absolutely impossible.
Then... today I WILL win... Rika.\nWhatever it takes...
'Aim for first place only.\nTo that end, all effort is\nobligatory'
That's the club's creed.\nIt matches that spirit.
Interesting!\nWhat game do you want today?
Isn't there something like...\na game that's purely about 'luck'?
Then this one~.\nMii~i☆\n'Hinamizawa Gyagya Sugoroku'~!
The name has a vaguely bloody ring to it, but...\nokay, that one...
First, rock-paper-scissors.\nRock-paper-scissors... go!
Mii~.\nI lost.\nThen I'll roll the dice.
Mii~. A 5.\nA great roll right off the bat.
1, 2, 3... 5 lands here.\nFollow the instructions.
'I badmouthed the curry and got chewed out by the teacher like crazy! Move back 1' -\nwhat IS this?
Too bad~.\nNext is my turn.\nHere! ...6!
6 lands here...\n'Everyone praised my Watanagashi kagura dance!\nMove forward 10'
Eeeeeh!?
Yay! Yay~.\nI advanced like half the board in one go~.
Next~.\nWhoa, amazing!\nIt's a 6!
'Ohagi with a needle... move back 3'\nUrgh... why am I barely advancing...?
My turn. Here!\n...2... what a shame.
1, 2... 'A cool transfer student arrived!\nMove forward 12'\nYay! All good in the end~.
N-no way...\nI need a comeback... ah!\nA s-six!
Amazing!\nYou're on a roll!
Umm... 6 is...\n'Hinamizawa Great Disaster... return to start'\n...What is this grim calamity...
Goshuusho-sama.\nNamuami.\nThat aside, it's my turn.
...2. But I'm at the goal.\nI'm sorry for winning\nso anticlimactically. Mii~.
...Another total defeat...?\nWhy... sniff.
If you cry, it's a 'meh', you know.
Poor poor thing, but\na club-rule penalty game is absolute.\nToday you wear this toy swan neck.
Heave-ho... heave-ho...\nEquipped!~
Urgh... this is embarrassing...
I'm cheering for you,\nso hang in there for an hour.\nNipah~☆
Penalty games... scare me...\nCan I ever break out of this loop?
...You always... like that...\n...This time too... ...that's why...
Hm? Rika?\nIt looks like you're walking and talking with someone...
...I know... ...you don't have to tell me...\n...I just want to believe in possibility till the very end...
...No... that's wrong! You know it too, really.
If our feelings are strong enough, fate can change...\nWe've learned that...
Huh? Rika...\nWho are you talking to...?\nI don't see anyone...
...!\nWho's there!? Show yourself.
Huh?\nUm... what should I do...
I'll pretend to be an animal and... bluff my way out.\n...Woof woof.\nUrgh... this is embarrassing in its own way.
A doggy?\nQuite the embarrassed\nlittle doggy.
Ah, sorry...\nI didn't mean to eavesdrop.
...Mii~. Who is it?\nEven apologized to,\nI can't see against the light...
It's me... though.
Mii~☆\nWere you stalking me again?\nYou're a troubled pervert.
N-no, that's wrong!\nI was just a little curious, that's all...
Is something the matter~.
No... um...\n...Rika,\nweren't you just talking with someone?
You were watching?\nWhat a pervert.\nI'll report you to the police~.
Hey-!\nDon't make me sound so bad...!
She's my 'little friend'.
The one I was talking with earlier.
Mii~.\nShe's a little friend only I can see.
...No, but...
You don't believe me?\nIf that's how it is...
I'd be so sad...\nI might cry...\n*sniff sniff*...
Waaah...!\nI-I believe you, I believe you!\nAn invisible friend, I believe it.
Yay~! I'm so happy you believe me.\nNipah~☆
And they all lived happily ever after.\nSee you next week.\nBye-bye-bye~.
Ah, yeah... see you...
...She left laughing...
Still... an invisible friend...\nWell... I get it, though...
I've got this right hand of mine, after all...
But... hmm... it bugs me...
'An invisible little friend'... huh...
Mii~. It's me~.
R-Rika...?\nDon't scare me like that...
You're always startling me,\nso this is payback.\nNipah~☆
A huge success!
But... you seem too surprised.\nDid something happen?
(It's hard to bring up the invisible friend...)
Umm... well...
I thought it might be a prank\nby Mion or Satoko...
That's entirely possible.\nYou'd better be careful.
I thought it might be that thing\nonly visible to espers who can stop time\nor restore broken things...
I get what you're trying to say,\nbut no comment.
Mii~... actually...\nyou want to talk about\nmy 'invisible little friend', don't you?
...Yes.\nIt's been bugging me\n ever since...
...Thank you for\nworrying about me.\nI'm really happy.
Rika... if something's bothering you...
Last time, I probably didn't\nexplain enough.\nBut I can't talk about it in detail yet.
Not until... I know you better...
I... see...\nRight...
Mii~☆\nDon't be so down.\nIt's not that I don't trust you.
But I want you to know just this.\nMy 'invisible little friend' is,\nto me, a very precious person.
Irreplaceable - half of who I am.
I understand... that's enough for me.\nSomeday, if there's a chance...
But... just one last question, if I may?
That friend... are they a 'good person'?\nThat's the only thing worrying me...
...Pfft... fufufufufu!
You really are a good person... truly...
Huh...? Um... uh...\nAm I being complimented...?
(Her tone just now felt different from usual...)
Of course.\nShe's a very good girl.
The answer's decided.\nShe's good.\nAbout as good as you.
Huh~?\nAbout as good as you - maybe\n'good' is overstating it.
Th-that's...\nWell, I don't think of myself as good, but...
Just kidding!\nIt's fine, so don't worry.\nNipah~☆
I see... then that's good.
(Despite her childish looks,\nshe seems to be holding all kinds of secrets...)
(I wish she'd open up to me\nabout more of it...)
I want to talk properly with Rika.\nShe still seems wary of me...\nAh! There's Rika.
Rika, want to do club...?
Yes~.\nGood work today, as always.
I heard your mumbling loud and clear.\nDo you do it unconsciously?
...Yes.\nI guess I was walking around talking to myself...
Well, fine. Today I thought up this match.\nTa-daa! 'Hinamizawa Kukeke Shiritori Card Game'~☆
Kukeke...?\nThe cards have single hiragana on them, like 'a' or 'mi'.
Shuffle these,\nand take three cards each as your hand.
Say one card is 'a'... then say a word\nthat starts with 'a' and ends with\none of the letters in your hand...
Then draw one from the pile\nand put it on the field.
You discard that hand to the field.\nFirst to empty their hand\nwins first place.
I see...\nIt's really 'shiritori'.\nAnd you can't end on 'n', right?
Right~.\nThe basic rules are shiritori's.
It's got to be a 'commonly known'\nword everyone knows.
Got it.
(My hand is... 'shi', 'ko', 'u')
Now flip the field card~.\nThe first letter is... 'hi'!
Umm... umm...
'Hinamizawa Great Disaster'!~
Huh...?\nThat's... not really a common word, is it...?
It's super common in Hinamizawa.\nNipah~☆
I... I see...\nThen... i... i... 'Inarizushi'!
'Queen Carrier'!
Eeeh!?\nWhat is that...?\nThat's kind of scary...
Even kids in Hinamizawa know that word.\nIt's common.
Umm... local rules, I guess...\nY-ya... 'Yakiuchi'!
Mii~. Quite the violent word.\nMy last card is 'tsu'...\nA word starting with 'chi' and ending in 'tsu'...
My last card is 'u'...\nA word starting with 'chi' and ending in 'u' is...\numm...
'Chinsuko'!
'Underground Torture Chamber'!
...A tie...!\nIn that case, the ruling is...?
What's 'chinsuko'? I don't know it.\nIt sounds a little naughty.
It's nothing like that!\n'Chinsuko' is an Okinawan snack.\nIt's super famous.
And 'Underground Torture Chamber'...\nis hardly common either...
That's not true.\nIn Hinamizawa it's a word used\nin everyday life.
Huh... Hinamizawa is...\ngiving me a really scary image now.
Urgh... nothing's coming...
Then if I can say one,\nI win.
'Chi'... 'tsu'...\n.........\nMii~. Nothing's coming.
So, it's a draw~.
Yes... that seems fair.
You did well this time.\nEven though it was your first time playing.\nGood job, good job.
Ah, thank you...
I think a little better of you now.\nNipah~☆
You're playing with me again today?\nDoing club together with you is\nsomething I always look forward to.
Really!?
To be precise...
What I look forward to is\nwatching you squirm in embarrassment\ntaking a penalty game. Nipah~☆
Devil words with an angel's smile...\nRika, you're terrifying...
Ufufu...
(And that grown-up laugh... a mystery...)
Today I wanted to settle last time's 'shiritori card game',\nbut doing the same game again shows no artistry.
So... this!☆
Hm?\nThose are... badminton rackets and a shuttlecock.
'Hinamizawa Au-Au Shiritori Badminton'!
You play badminton\nwhile doing 'shiritori'!
With the shuttlecock, you have to return\nthe shiritori too.\nAnd it's single-match.
No mistakes allowed, then...
It's harder than you'd imagine\nwhen you actually try.\nBut the 'restrictions' are loose.
Not just single words - long sentences are OK.\nYou can say anything\nuntil you hit the shuttlecock back.
Of course, if you end on 'n',\nyou're out.
...Understood.\nConsidering the stamina gap, I'll yield the serve.
Thank you~. I'll take you up on that.\nHere I go?
Ready... 'Hinamizawa'!~.
I've got to think before the shuttlecock falls...\nW-wa... 'Watanagashi'!
Nice return~.\nSh... sh...\n'Human-canned-meat suspicion'!
Whoa! A smash!\nK-kuh...!\n'Be cool'!
You're pretty good...!\nRe... re...\n'Duel with Rena!'!
I'll swing you side to side a bit...\n'That's a lie!'!
I'm... getting winded...!\nD-da...\n'Dam construction supporters'...!
My chance...!\nHa... ha...
'Losers... have no place in this world'\nSMAAASH!!
Umm... it went in... right?\nI won...?
Hah... hah...
Ah...!\nRika, you ran all over - you must be tired.\nSorry, are you okay?
'Losers have no place in this world'...\nThat's...
I wonder what that was...\nit just came to my mind.
But badminton goes to whoever has more stamina...\nand I'm bigger than you.
Why don't we call this match a draw?\nWe'll settle it another time.
You really are...
...No, never mind.\nSo I don't have to take\na penalty game?
Then, instead of a 'punishment'...\nI'll give you a 'thank-you'.
No, I'm the one who should thank you.\nYou keep humoring me\njust because I can't win...
That's fine.\nI had fun too.\nNothing weird about me giving the thanks.
Umm... what will you do for me?
What would you like?\nI'll do something within\nwhat a kid like me can do.
Anyway, look forward to next time~.\nI'm sure you'll love it.\nNipah~☆
I wonder what it'll be...\nA thank-you... I'm a little happy...
Where~ is it?
Ah, good, you were here.\nCome with me.
Huh. Sure, but...\nwhere are we going?
Mii~, that's a secret~.\nThis way, this way~.
Where is this...?\nI don't... recognize it.
This is a 'cosplay café'~.\nNipah~☆
Do you like... cosplaying girls\nand stuff?
I've never thought about whether I like it or not...\nI don't dislike it.
That's good~.\nToday I'm giving you\nthat 'thank-you' from before.
Nipah~☆\nWait just a bit~.
Thanks for waiting~☆
Mii~, don't go quiet on me...\nD-do I... look okay?
It suits you so well.\nYou're cute...
Good...\nI'm so, so happy\nyou're pleased.
Ah, that's right. I made tea and cake~.\nPlease, help yourself~.
Looks delicious.\nItadakimasu!
How does it taste~?
It's delicious!\nI've never had anything this good...
Yay yay~☆\nI'm glad I worked hard making it~.
Huh? You made it yourself?\nThat's amazing. You can do anything, Rika...
Umm, uh...
I want... a reward...\nI worked hard making the cake... reward...
Yes. Of course.\nLet me thank you properly.
...On your lap...\ncarry me... please...
...Is that... not okay?
...If that's all, then.\nOf course, that's fine.
Thank you~! Then I'll take you up on that.\nHeave-ho... heave-ho...
...It's warm...\nNipah~☆
I'll feed you cake~.\nHere... say 'ah'...
Fufufu... keep eating and eating~.\nHere, say 'ah'.
I'm happy.\nIt's like a dream...
...Phew.\nIt was... a dream.
Ah, you're awake~.
Rika!\nAh, I keep picturing the cosplay...
I don't know what you're talking about~.
You were probably lying in wait for me,\ndozed off, and had a dream.
Not knowing dreams from reality -\nwhat a troubled sleepyhead you are~.
But...\nthat easygoing side of you...\nI don't hate it.
Huh...?\nWhat did you just...
Mii? I didn't say anything~.
I... see?
That's right~.\nNipah~☆
Well, I've got things to do,\nso I'll be going.\nBye-bye-bye~.
